content.user_title: Organize Complex Work with Planning Files
content.value_statement: Long tasks can lose context, decisions, and recovery notes. This skill keeps plans, notes, and deliverables in markdown files that agents can reread and update.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to create task_plan.md before complex work.
Defines a three-file pattern using task_plan.md, notes.md, and a deliverable file.
Provides reusable templates for plans, research notes, and final deliverables.
Encourages reading the plan before major decisions to refresh task goals.
Records errors and decisions in persistent markdown sections for later review.
Shows workflows for research, bug fixing, feature work, and error recovery.
limitations: It does not execute project tasks or validate final deliverables by itself.
It creates local markdown files, so users should avoid storing secrets in shared workspaces.
It is most useful for multi-step tasks and can add overhead for simple questions.
It depends on the agent following the workflow consistently.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Research Assignments
use_cases.description: Use task_plan.md and notes.md to collect sources, track questions, and produce a clear final summary.

use_cases.title: Manage Feature Work
use_cases.description: Track implementation phases, decisions, errors, and deliverables while building or changing software.

use_cases.title: Structure Long Writing Projects
use_cases.description: Separate plans, collected notes, and final drafts so long writing tasks stay organized.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Step Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the planning-with-files workflow for this task: [describe task]. Create task_plan.md first, then update it as work progresses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start a complex task with a persistent plan.

prompt_templates.title: Research and Synthesize
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan this research task with task_plan.md, store findings in notes.md, and produce a concise deliverable: [research question].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: keep sources and synthesis separate.

prompt_templates.title: Track a Development Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning files to manage this engineering request: [feature or bug]. Log decisions, errors, files touched, and verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate implementation work over several phases.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a Stalled Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the existing planning files for [project], summarize current status, identify blockers, and update the next steps before continuing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: resume work after a long or interrupted session.

output_examples.input: Research a market trend and create a summary.
output_examples.output: A task_plan.md file lists research phases. A notes.md file stores source findings. A final summary file presents the synthesized answer.

output_examples.input: Fix a login bug in an application.
output_examples.output: The plan tracks diagnosis, root cause, implementation, and tests. Decisions and errors are recorded before the final fix summary.

output_examples.input: Add a dark mode toggle to a settings page.
output_examples.output: Planning files capture the theme approach, files to modify, implementation phases, and final delivery notes.

best_practices: Check for existing planning files before creating new ones.
Keep sensitive data out of notes in shared or public repositories.
Update status, decisions, and errors immediately after each major step.
anti_patterns: Using the workflow for a one-step answer that does not need tracking.
Letting task_plan.md become stale while work continues.
Storing large unrelated documents in the plan instead of linking to separate files.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides markdown planning instructions and examples. Any file actions depend on the host agent and user permissions.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it for complex or multi-step tasks that need tracking, research notes, decisions, or recovery history.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing files?
faq.answer: It may ask the agent to create common filenames. Check existing files and rename plans when needed.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It is written as general workflow guidance and declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can I use it without three files?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the full pattern for complex tasks, and skip or merge files for smaller work.

faq.question: How does it improve context?
faq.answer: It keeps goals, decisions, and notes in files that can be reread when the conversation becomes long.
